manifest.name: geo-site-diagnose
input_files: file-backed fixture: bounded replay HTML, robots.txt, and sitemap snapshots for governed evaluation
manifest.rollback_boundary: Remove generated site-diagnosis run directories and revert the site-diagnose runtime, Registry entry, schemas, packaging, and provider package together.

frontmatter.name: geo-site-diagnose
frontmatter.description: Crawl one public website from a supplied URL, select up to ten representative page types, score evidence-lined GEO readiness, and generate a standalone visual HTML report. Use for 网站 GEO 诊断、全站 GEO 体检、网站 GEO 审计, or requests such as “帮我诊断网站GEO并附上网址”. Excludes single-page or brand-only diagnosis, live AI ranking or citation measurement, authenticated sites, and website modification.

interface.display_name: GEOHub 网站 GEO 诊断
interface.short_description: 从一个网址生成最多十类页面的 GEO 可视化诊断报告
interface.default_prompt: Use $geo-site-diagnose to crawl this public website within the governed limits and return the standalone visual GEO diagnosis report.

optional.locale: Chinese or English locale; defaults to zh-CN for Chinese requests and normalizes English requests to en-US
optional.render: auto | http | browser; defaults to auto

permission_contract.filesystem: read packaged assets and write the selected runs root
permission_contract.network: one explicit public website and same-host bounded discovery only
